title: Make deep SwiftPM packages survive Windows path limits
description: Make Swift builds work from deep Windows source topology by assigning path-budgeted SwiftPM scratch state without renaming canonical product identities or silently leaking unbounded build directories.

historicalContent.triggeredBy: A DocC proof package rooted at 193 characters caused SwiftPM's dependency repository paths to reach 304 characters and fail Git revision resolution with '$GIT_DIR too big'. A short scratch path cleared that failure and exposed a separate DocC Windows archive defect.
acceptanceCriteria: Vaporize predicts when inline .build descendants exceed a conservative Windows path budget.
Deep Windows packages receive a deterministic short SwiftPM scratch path by default.
Short packages and all non-Windows callers retain existing behavior.
Path-budget exhaustion warns with an actionable shorter-root override rather than blocking unrelated work.
A follow-on lease service owns disk quotas, expiry, cleanup, and pressure notifications so short scratch state cannot grow without bound.
historicalContent.scopeBoundary: This slice admits path planning and command adoption. It does not rename the substrate topology, claim that every Windows DocC defect is a path defect, or hide scratch lifecycle debt.
